svg.title: Three lines, then one question
svg.desc: A round plate is scored across the middle. Three sighting lamps stand on the near side. One aims a solid line across the score at a lantern, which glows: a question sent along that line has just reached it. The other two lines are still dashed drafts, crossing on the near side inside an empty dashed outline of the lantern, where the sketch imagined the listener.
